title: On the Regularity and Clean Properties of Matrices over Dual Numbers
summary: In this paper, we study regularity and clean-type decompositions for matrices over dual numbers. We characterize the von Neumann regularity of dual matrices by establishing a necessary and sufficient compatibility condition between their real and dual components. At the element level, we determine the conditions under which an individual dual matrix $\mathcal{M} = A + Bε$ is regular, $π$-regular, nil-clean, or strongly nil-clean. Using the solvability of Sylvester matrix equations, we show that the matrix ring over dual numbers $M_n(\mathbb{D})$ is strongly $π$-regular and strongly clean.…
